app.pages.competitions.cups.title: Aztec Cups
app.pages.competitions.cups.paragraph.1: Aztec Cups are weekly tournaments held every Sunday evening, serving as a qualifying stage for the prestigious Aztec Arena.
app.pages.competitions.cups.paragraph.2: Historically, these competitions have allowed teams to face off in a 3 BO1 single-elimination format, with €50 at stake for the winner.
app.pages.competitions.cups.paragraph.3: A real springboard for emerging talent, the Aztec Cups offer players an opportunity to prove their worth and climb the ladder to the high-level competitive scene.
app.pages.competitions.arena.title: Aztec Arena
app.pages.competitions.arena.paragraph.1: The Aztec Arena is a major tournament bringing together the best Counter-Strike 2 teams, with a cash prize of €500 at stake.
app.pages.competitions.arena.paragraph.2: Initially contested with 16 teams, the competition has now evolved into a more selective format with 8 teams qualifying through different methods:
app.pages.competitions.arena.paragraph.3:
• 4 teams that won an Aztec Cup and secured their direct ticket.
  • 4 teams selected through a points system, rewarding their consistency and commitment, or invited if they compete at the Advanced level or higher.
app.pages.competitions.arena.paragraph.4: The Aztec Arena is the final stage of the Aztec competitions, offering an intense challenge and a high-level spectacle for players and spectators alike.
app.pages.organisation.title: What abouts us ?
app.pages.organisation.content.paragraph: Aztec was founded by former semi-professional CS:GO and CS2 players, with a dual expertise in the field and in organisation. We know what makes a good tournament, because we've experienced it from both sides. Thanks to more than 20 events organised (Aztec Cup, Arena, 3DMAX tournaments, IESF Qualifers), we can now offer reliable and professional services: tailor-made formats, controlled production, quality casting.
Our strength: a human approach, rooted in the reality of the players, and a level of standards that live up to the expectations of our partners.
app.pages.organisation.services.title: Our services
app.pages.organisation.service.event.des:
We can provide you with full support for your event:

  • Planning management and logistics coordination
  • Supervision of admins and technical staff
  • Creation of appropriate formats (groups, brackets, BOs, etc.)
  • Optimising the event to suit the budget
  • Scouting teams to ensure quality posters
app.pages.organisation.service.casting.d:
Aztec offers professional casting services for Counter-Strike 2, combining dynamism, clarity and game expertise. Whether for tournaments, showmatches or community events, we'll be there for you.

  • A lively narrative that adds pace to every round
  • Better audience retention thanks to an engaging cast
  • A more professional image for your event or stream
  • Optimising the event in line with the budgett
  • Added value to the show, even for the uninitiated
app.pages.organisation.service.obs.title: Match/tournament observer
app.pages.organisation.service.obs.descr:
We also offer a spotting service to enhance the broadcasting of your tournaments:

  • Live stream or broadcast (2K 60fps 20,000kbps/S)
  • Fixed and moving camera shots created by us
  • Remote control
  • Instant replay system
  • Live capture of the most memorable moments of the matches
